data.text: Owner approved every --json contract change of 2026-10-04 (asked first, per CLAUDE.md): search gains 'also' (always an array; with phrasings hits are in fused order and score/coverage are the best phrasing's); doc show DOC-N:a-b puts those lines in body and adds section {from,to,lines}, bytes stays the whole document (DEC-47); prime gains staleDocumentation and staleDocumentationTotal; task show documentation[] gains stale; error code note_not_found. Also accepted as they are: stemming reaches task list --search (filter gate unchanged at 0.35), and 'note show' is now a reserved word like 'note list'.
